text:
eli: Heads-up — planning a small autoscaler parameter bump for the dedicated-gpu pool (pool:dgx-small) tonight 23:00 UTC. Change summary: min_replicas 2 -> 3, scale_down_delay 10m -> 3m. Need a deploy owner, someone to watch smoke for 30m, and rollback readiness. @jon @liz

jon: I can own the deploy if PR gets a quick +1 and someone watches the smoke window. I’ll be on standby from 22:45 UTC.

maya: PR ready: #4823. Adds the param override and a rollout flag. Tests included. Link: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/pulls/4823

liz: I can do smoke monitoring. Can we do a staged rollout (10% canary -> 50% -> 100%) so I can validate eviction / latency metrics before full cutover? Also need the rollback command handy.

jon: PR contains a rollout schedule: 10% for 10m, 50% for 10m, then 100%. Rollback plan: revert rollout flag or run:

```
# quick rollback
kubectl -n redwood apply -f manifests/autoscaler/rollback-minreplicas.yaml
```

That file sets min_replicas back to 2 and resets scale_down_delay to 10m.

sam: quick question — will bumping min_replicas to 3 change placement on the small pool nodes? Could cause bin-packing and preemptions on shared hosts. Did staging test include node consolidation checks?

eli: Staging runs included packing sims, no preemptions observed at current load. Policy change is conservative (+1 replica). We can gate if we see unscheduled evictions.

liz: Smoke checklist (short):
- confirm canary applied to 10% slice (routing / selector)
- watch autoscaler-controller logs for scale events (grep controller:autoscaler)
- check pool utilization dashboard at /dash/pools/dgx-small (cpu/gpu/mem)
- verify no new OOMKilled or container restarts in last 5m
- run 5 synthetic inference requests against canary to validate latency p50/p95
- if anything >20% increase p95 or unexpected evictions -> rollback

jon: I'll add the canary selector to the rollout in the PR. Also adding a short helm hook to emit a deploy-event to #incidents in case of failure.

maya: Heads-up on metrics alerts to mute: temporarily disable the autoscaler-surge alert for this 45m window so we don't drown the channel. I’ll handle mute and re-enable after.

deploy-bot: Deploy window: scheduled by jon at 2024-11-07T23:00:00Z. Runbook: https://runbooks.internal/redwood/dedicated-autoscaler-rollout. Notifying on-call.

eli: Final checks: PR merged by 22:50 UTC, jon starts rollout at 23:00, liz monitors 23:00–23:30, maya handles alert mutes. If canary looks good after 20m -> continue to 50% then 100%.

liz: I’ll post short updates during the smoke window (every 10m).

jon: Merging now, will DM when I hit the rollout job. :rocket:
_note: Thread follows agents.md schema: channel, timestamps, participants, and single continuous message string in 'text'
